scores.evidence: Density is correct at any scope (environment.css:85-115 re-declares on :is([data-a63-density],[data-density]); density.browser.test.ts:75-84 tests nested). Radius and type scale are not: --radius-* are declared on :root only (foundation/radius.css:12-37) and --typography-*-font-size on :root/@media/[data-window-size] (foundation/typography.css:18-50), so a nested [data-a63-radius] or [data-a63-type-scale] only changes the multiplier, not the derived tokens. personalization-axes.md:4 promises every axis is "applied at any scope", and radius.css:14 says `default` exists "so a subtree can override back". n/a: no color pairs on this subject.

Two type-scale levers with different names and multipliers: [data-a63-type-scale] compact/normal/comfortable/large = 0.9/1/1.1/1.2 (type-scale.css:12-26) and .text-scale-sm/normal/lg/xl = 0.8/1/1.2/1.4 (foundation/typography.css @layer base), the classes used nowhere outside generated indexes (git grep). Alias chains: --a63-radius-control -> --a63-control-radius (radius.css:18, control.css:69); --radius duplicates --radius-md (foundation/radius.css:16,21). radius.css comment says --radius-full is "2x md", code is 2x xl (:29-32) (r1-tokens-13).

Type ramp is not monotonic or proportional: 15->16 (base->lg), 18->19 (xl->2xl), 39->40 (9xl->10xl) are 1px steps, then 40->56; line heights fall going up: lg 24px > xl 23px, 9xl 49px > 10xl 44px (foundation/typography.css:25-50). Radius ramp switches step from 0.2 to 0.4 of the anchor above lg (radius.css:18-28), acceptable. Density is proportional (space-unit x 0.875, control heights round to px, environment.css:86-109; density.browser.test.ts:108) but --a63-space-* are not rounded, so compact gives 1.75px/5.25px paddings (r1-tokens-14, r1-tokens-24). Motion ramp 150/250/400/450/500/1000ms with reduced-motion zeroing (motion.css:22-29) is fine.

findings.subject: Brand axis (b1-b6, auto; brand-ramp.css, brand-action.css)
findings.summary: A nested brand scope (UIProvider brand=...) switches the primary fill but not the other brand-derived semantics: links, focus ring, accent selection, chart-1 and choice-card tints stay on the root brand.
findings.evidence: provider.tsx:68 stamps only data-a63-brand; brand-action.css:14-15 declares primary on [data-a63-brand], but semantics.css:161,209,269,301,360,395,445 declare --a63-text-accent, --a63-focus-ring, --a63-chart-1, --a63-selected-accent-background only on :root,.light,[data-a63-mode]. No test renders a nested brand (contrast.browser.test.ts:230 sets the root only). personalization-axes.md:112-116 states the rule this breaks.
findings.fix: Declare every token that reads --a63-brand-* or --a63-action-primary on the brand scope too (add [data-a63-brand] to the light-mode selector in semantics.resolver.json output, with the dark values under :is(.dark,[data-a63-mode=dark]) [data-a63-brand] or by moving them into brand-action), and add a nested-brand case to contrast.browser.test.ts and figma-parity.

verified.reason: The mechanism is real and I reproduced it from the source. brand-action.css:14-15 redeclares primary on [data-a63-brand]. semantics.css:95-97 and :306 declare --a63-text-accent (161/360), --a63-focus-ring (209/395), --a63-chart-1 (269/416) and --a63-selected-accent-background (301/445) only on :root, .light and [data-a63-mode]. provider.tsx:68 stamps data-a63-brand alone, so under a nested UIProvider brand=... with no mode those tokens inherit values already resolved against the root brand. This contradicts personalization-axes.md 'Declare derived tokens on the scope that changes them'. The severity is inflated, though. The main personalization path stamps the brand on the document root (apply-personalization.ts:48), where everything resolves correctly. Passing mode together with brand also fixes it, because the [data-a63-mode] block then redeclares on the same element. The only in-repo nested usages (button.stories.tsx:692, switch.stories.tsx:327) pass brand together with mode. The defect only hits brand-without-mode nesting, so it does not block 'ready'.

findings.subject: Surface axis and surface tint (n1-n6, --a63-surface-tint)
findings.summary: A nested surface scope (UIProvider surface=...) remaps the neutral ramp but the semantic surfaces, text and borders keep the root palette.
findings.evidence: surface.css:9-40 remaps --surface-light-*/--surface-dark-* on [data-a63-surface]; semantics.css:100-185 and :307-379 consume them on the mode scope only; provider.tsx:73 stamps data-a63-surface alone; --a63-surface-tint only on :root (semantics.css:14).
findings.fix: Declare the surface-dependent semantics on [data-a63-surface] (and the tint consumers wherever --a63-surface-tint may be set), same fix shape as r1-tokens-1; add a nested-surface test.

verified.reason: Real, by the same mechanism as r1-tokens-1. surface.css remaps --surface-light-*/--surface-dark-* on [data-a63-surface]. semantics.css consumes them only in the :root,.light,[data-a63-mode] block (95-185) and the dark block (306-379). provider.tsx:73 stamps data-a63-surface alone, and --a63-surface-tint is declared only on :root (semantics.css:14). So nested surface= without mode is effectively a no-op for semantic surfaces, text and borders. Root-level personalization works, and nesting with mode works, so this is P2, not P1.

findings.subject: shadcn reverse bridge (compat/a63-from-shadcn.css)
findings.summary: The reverse shadcn bridge leaves 139 tokens that ui-react recipes read without a fallback undefined, so a shadcn host following the README gets collapsed spacing, invisible selected states and missing type/disabled styling.
findings.evidence: Scripted measurement over the 72 files imported by packages/ui-react/src/styles/recipes.css: 234 --a63-* reads without fallback, 21 declared in recipes, 107 declared in compat/a63-from-shadcn.css, 139 missing (e.g. --a63-space-0_5 x16 files, --a63-space-1_5 x7, --a63-text-accent x8, --a63-selected-background/-foreground, --a63-selected-accent-*, --a63-action-disabled-*, --a63-type-display-*, --a63-font-app, --a63-category-*). README: packages/styles/README.md shadcn table; consumer: packages/mdx/src/styles/shadcn.css:11. Only test: recipes.test.ts:78-81 (four strings).
findings.fix: Either import the contracts and the non-color foundation (space, type, motion, radius) from the reverse entry and define the remaining color roles from shadcn names, or generate a63-from-shadcn.css from the manifest; add a test that every no-fallback --a63-* read in recipes.css resolves when only a63-from-shadcn + recipes.css are loaded.

verified.reason: I reproduced the measurement with a script over the 71 files that recipes.css @imports. It found 234 --a63-* reads with no fallback; 139 are declared neither in the recipes nor in compat/a63-from-shadcn.css. Missing examples: --a63-space-0_5 (16 files), --a63-space-1_5 (7), --a63-text-accent (8), --a63-selected-background/-foreground (3), --a63-selected-accent-* (4), plus control-feedback-ease/duration (40/39) and control-icon-size-*. The bridge (158 lines) has no @import to supply them. It is an exported entry (styles/package.json:33), documented for external shadcn hosts (README.md:194,227), and consumed by mdx/src/styles/shadcn.css:11. Because the tokens are undefined, padding collapses to 0, selected washes become transparent and icon sizes fall back to defaults, which is a documented path that is broken in practice. Some of the misses (overlay gloss/texture) degrade harmlessly to none, but the spacing and selected-state misses are enough to block 'ready'.

findings.evidence: contrast.browser.test.ts never sets data-a63-surface or --a63-surface-tint; semantics.css:155-158,176-180 claim AA/3:1 on every surface.
findings.fix: Loop surfaces n1-n6 and tint 0/50/100% in the core and brand contrast tests.

findings.subject: Surface axis and surface tint (n1-n6, --a63-surface-tint)
findings.summary: Adding a neutral surface palette has no documented procedure and no list check.
findings.evidence: theme-authoring.md has only "Adding a brand"; brand-lists.mjs covers brands only; surfaces n1-n6 are hand-listed in figma-parity.browser.test.ts:152, generate-figma-sync.mjs and ui-foundation axes.ts.
findings.fix: Document "Adding a surface" and generalise brand-lists.mjs to surfaces.

findings.subject: Scales and ergonomic axes (space, type, radius, motion; density, radius, type-scale, font)
findings.summary: Radius and type-scale axes only take effect on the root, contrary to the docs.
findings.evidence: foundation/radius.css:12-37 and foundation/typography.css:18-50 declare the derived tokens on :root/@media/[data-window-size]; [data-a63-radius]/[data-a63-type-scale] set only the multiplier (radius.css:21-38, type-scale.css:12-26). personalization-axes.md:4 "applied at any scope"; radius.css:14 "so a subtree can override back". Tests set the root only (personalization-axes.browser.test.ts:13-112). apply-personalization.ts:55-56 stamps the root, so the default path works.
findings.fix: Re-declare the derived radius and type tokens on [data-a63-radius] and [data-a63-type-scale] (as density does in environment.css:93), add nested tests; or state in the docs that these two axes are root-only.

findings.subject: Scales and ergonomic axes (space, type, radius, motion; density, radius, type-scale, font)
findings.summary: Two type-scale mechanisms with different names and multipliers, plus duplicate radius aliases.
findings.evidence: [data-a63-type-scale] 0.9/1/1.1/1.2 (type-scale.css) vs .text-scale-sm/normal/lg/xl 0.8/1/1.2/1.4 (foundation/typography.css @layer base), the classes unused in source; --a63-radius-control -> --a63-control-radius (radius.css:18, control.css:69); --radius == --radius-md (foundation/radius.css:16,21); comment "2x md" on a 2x xl value (:29-32).
findings.fix: Remove the .text-scale-* classes (or alias them to the attribute values); fold --a63-radius-control into --a63-control-radius; fix the comment.

findings.subject: Scales and ergonomic axes (space, type, radius, motion; density, radius, type-scale, font)
findings.summary: The type ramp has 1px steps and descending line heights, so adjacent sizes are indistinguishable and leading is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: foundation/typography.css:25-50: base 15 / lg 16, xl 18 / 2xl 19, 9xl 39 / 10xl 40 then 11xl 56; line heights lg 24 > xl 23 and 9xl 49 > 10xl 44.
findings.fix: Decide the ramp on a ratio (or drop redundant steps) and keep line height monotonic; add a test that sizes and line heights increase.

findings.subject: Tailwind bridge (tailwind/roles.json, tailwind/theme.css)
findings.summary: The Tailwind bridge has no danger status roles and no roles for tertiary, accent or danger text.
findings.evidence: roles.json:41-60 has info/success/warning with -foreground/-subtle/-subtle-foreground; no status-danger; destructive-subtle maps to --a63-action-danger-subtle. No role for --a63-text-tertiary/-accent/-danger, --a63-border-control, --a63-surface-recessed (git grep: 7 arbitrary text-(--a63-...) uses).
findings.fix: Add danger, danger-foreground, danger-subtle, danger-subtle-foreground (status-danger) and text roles (e.g. tertiary-foreground, accent-foreground, danger-foreground naming to be chosen once) to roles.json and regenerate.

findings.subject: shadcn forward bridge (compat/shadcn.css)
findings.summary: In a brand-only or surface-only subtree the forward shadcn aliases keep the root values.
findings.evidence: shadcn.css:14-17 selectors :root,.light,.dark,[data-a63-mode]; brand-action.css:14-15 changes --a63-action-primary on [data-a63-brand], so --primary and --a63-action-primary disagree inside <UIProvider brand=...>.
findings.fix: Generate the bridge on [data-a63-brand],[data-a63-surface],[data-a63-theme] too (generate-role-bridges.mjs), together with r1-tokens-1.

findings.subject: shadcn reverse bridge (compat/a63-from-shadcn.css)
findings.summary: The reverse bridge is declared on :root only, so a nested .dark subtree in a shadcn host keeps the root values.
findings.evidence: a63-from-shadcn.css:15; the forward bridge solves this by declaring on every mode scope (shadcn.css:8-17).
findings.fix: Declare the mapping on :root,.light,.dark,[data-a63-mode] like the forward bridge.

findings.subject: shadcn reverse bridge (compat/a63-from-shadcn.css)
findings.summary: Reverse-bridge status foregrounds are hard-coded white and fail contrast on the bridge's own fallback fills.
findings.evidence: a63-from-shadcn.css:40-45: white on oklch(0.75 0.15 80) = 2.26:1, on oklch(0.65 0.16 150) = 3.02:1 (computed).
findings.fix: Use the same oklch auto-contrast expression as semantics.css:234-264, or var(--warning-foreground, <auto>).

findings.subject: Semantic color layer and modes (tokens/semantics.css, brand-action.css)
findings.summary: Danger and neutral button labels are tested at 3:1 though they are normal-size text.
findings.evidence: contrast.browser.test.ts:30-33 (primary at 4.5:1 with the comment that labels are text; neutral and danger at AA_UI 3:1). Today white on danger-600 is 6.34:1, so this is a guard gap.
findings.fix: Raise both pairs to 4.5:1.

findings.subject: Themes (modern, aqua, retro, terminal)
findings.summary: Themes restate base values (none, 2px, 0 0 #0000) that the contracts already default to.
findings.evidence: sweep-r1/token-economy.log: --a63-weather-backdrop none (aqua/retro/terminal), --a63-control-gloss none (retro/terminal), --a63-choice-indicator-gloss none, --a63-control-shadow-flat (modern).
findings.fix: Drop the restatements from the theme resolvers, or mark them intentional so the advisory list shrinks to real issues.

findings.subject: Figma sync model (generated/atom63.figma-sync.json)
findings.summary: No check that the live Figma library matches the sync model; 64 computed tokens appear only at their default.
findings.evidence: check:figma compares the generated JSON with CSS only (package.json "check:figma"); figma-sync.json computed[] = 64 (e.g. --a63-action-neutral varies on brand+mode+surface+theme per generated/atom63.computed-values.json).
findings.fix: Add a read-back check from the Figma plugin (apps/figma-plugin) or document the manual sync step and its last run date.

findings.subject: shadcn forward bridge (compat/shadcn.css)
findings.summary: README forward map is stale for --input.
findings.evidence: packages/styles/README.md shadcn table: `--input` -> `--a63-border-control`; generated shadcn.css:35 maps --a63-border-input. README "Canonical tokens" table also omits --a63-text-tertiary/-accent and --a63-border-input.
findings.fix: Generate the README table from roles.json or correct it.

findings.subject: Scales and ergonomic axes (space, type, radius, motion; density, radius, type-scale, font)
findings.summary: Compact density produces fractional spacing.
findings.evidence: environment.css:86,94-103: space-unit = 4px x 0.875, so --a63-space-0_5 = 1.75px, -1_5 = 5.25px, -2_5 = 8.75px; density.browser.test.ts:108 checks whole pixels only for control heights and row padding.
findings.fix: round(nearest, ..., 1px) the --a63-space-* steps like the control heights, and extend the whole-pixel test.

findings.subject: Themes (modern, aqua, retro, terminal)
findings.summary: Some axis combinations are never resolved together in a test.
findings.evidence: figma-parity checks theme x brand x surface x mode and each other axis alone (figma-parity.browser.test.ts:139-153); theme x density x design-language, and a nested brand under a theme root, are not combined.
findings.fix: Add a small pairwise matrix (theme x density x design-language x input) asserting every contract token resolves non-empty.

findings.subject: Semantic color layer and modes (tokens/semantics.css, brand-action.css)
findings.summary: Computed and skipped tokens are excluded from the resolution check.
findings.evidence: figma-parity.browser.test.ts:14-18 skips the 64 computed tokens and anything aliasing them; 279 skipped entries (figma-sync.json summary).
findings.fix: Add a plain "resolves non-empty in every context" assertion for the excluded tokens, independent of Figma representability.

findings.subject: Brand axis (b1-b6, auto; brand-ramp.css, brand-action.css)
findings.summary: The axis doc misstates where the focus ring lives.
findings.evidence: personalization-axes.md:71 "--a63-focus-ring (in tokens/brand.css, scoped to [data-a63-brand])"; actual semantics.css:209,395 on the mode scope; README "Primary action and focus ring are brand-derived in brand-action.resolver.json".
findings.fix: Fix with r1-tokens-1 (moving the focus ring to the brand scope makes the doc true).

findings.subject: Tailwind bridge (tailwind/roles.json, tailwind/theme.css)
findings.summary: secondary-foreground maps to the secondary text grey.
findings.evidence: roles.json:15 secondary-foreground -> --a63-text-secondary; shadcn uses it for the label of a secondary button, which expects primary-strength text.
findings.fix: Map secondary-foreground to --a63-text-primary, or document the choice.
